title: Five letter word guessing game
when: The user wants the daily word puzzle: six tries to guess a five letter word, each guess scored letter by letter as right spot, in the word, or absent.
prompt:
Goal: Correct scoring with repeated letters, a responsive keyboard and stats that persist.
Steps:
1. Local answer and allowed lists; daily index from whole local days since a fixed start date; also a free play mode.
2. logic.mjs score(guess, answer) in two passes: mark exact matches and count the rest of the answer letters, then mark present only while counts last; keyboardState keeps the best state per letter.
3. 6 rows of 5 cells; physical keys and an on screen keyboard of buttons; Enter submits, Backspace deletes.
4. Reject words not in the list with a shake and a role="alert" message.
5. Each cell aria-label "A, correct spot", "in the word" or "not in the word"; high contrast palette option; flip reveal off under prefers-reduced-motion.
6. Stats in localStorage guarded: played, win rate, streak, distribution; share as a text grid of letters.
7. test.mjs: repeated letters (answer ABBEY, guess BABES), all correct, invalid word.
Quality bar:
- Colors never the only signal.
- Keyboard hints match cell states.
- One game per day in daily mode.
Pitfalls:
- Marking a letter present more times than it occurs.
- Daily word changing at UTC midnight.
- Accepting guesses shorter than 5.
Verify:
- [ ] Scoring tested with duplicates.
- [ ] Alerts live.
- [ ] Reduced motion rule exists.
- [ ] node test.mjs passes.
Output: index.html, style.css, app.js, logic.mjs (scoring and daily index), words.js, test.mjs.

examples.input: jogo de adivinhar palavra de 5 letras em portugues
examples.output: 6x5 grid, on screen keyboard, daily word, stats and streak
